Name: Zimri, Son of Jehoadah
Summary: Son of Jehoadah and father of Moza.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:36; 1 Chronicles 9:42: Son of Jehoadah and father of Moza.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zimri stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
